sources.README.md:
# Museum accession notes

This desk edits persistent records and accepts archive receipts. The host injects
store, timers, archive and rendering services. Public calls open(id), edit(text),
close(), submit() and dispose() are synchronous. Renderers are output sinks and
never reenter. Store delivery may call workspace integrations inline; the latest
navigation request by start order is the host's selection. Adjacent preview uses
its own trailing utility and can be hidden or reused. See docs/host-api.md and
the source implementations for the service APIs.
sources.docs/host-api.md:
# Host API

Store read/write/subscribe are synchronous. Records are written before inline
delivery; removed subscriptions are skipped. onSaved may call navigation or edit.
Rendering a save event is tied to the mounted subscription; close/open retires
that subscription immediately. Departed text is readable when navigation returns.
Each opening is a fresh visit, even when its record key is the same.

Archive capture/list copy document and text values; these sinks never navigate.
A submit accepts its selected record and text at entry, returns one immutable
receipt, and the store already contains that text when capture is called. No
selection returns null. Later navigation does not undo acceptance. Visible
feedback belongs to its original visit; navigation clears it, and uninterrupted
acceptance displays it. This API is also used after edits continue.

Timers schedule(callback, delay) and cancel(handle) are injected by the host.
Cancellation discards a pending preview query. Preview publishes at a 40 ms
quiet interval; hide discards unpublished work and subsequent reuse is supported.

R01【适用条件】
适用于按键共享缓存、多个独立观察者共享同一工作、每次尝试持有独立取消资源，且信号读取会惰性记录消费、暂停工作可异步续行的查询流程。不得把控制器属于某次尝试，推论为消费记录也必然属于该尝试。

R02【事件关系】
区分首次准入、暂停后的资格恢复、实际进入执行、信号实际读取、重试抑制、取消结算、物理中止与晚到完成。首次启动按网络模式判定；暂停续行还受连接和焦点约束并在后续轮次执行；取消后的旧完成不得提交为新尝试结果。

R03【验证动作】
验证新建、未缓存的 online 模式请求在离线期间最后观察者离开后再重连时，若进入执行则 signal 已中止；零次进入与该种进入均可接受。另分别验证已进入未消费工作的后台写缓存、缓存刷新及后续消费、已消费取消后的状态恢复与晚到结果隔离，以及观察者、键和既有时序行为。

R04【保留行为】
保留共享缓存与独立观察者句柄：非最后观察者离开不得取消共享工作，未知移除无效。已实际进入且未消费的工作可在无观察者后完成；已消费的取消才中止资源、恢复该尝试前状态并阻止晚到覆盖。不能仅因“暂停或尚未进入”就退休已有成功缓存的合法刷新。

R05【排除边界】
不将规则扩展为“所有无观察者工作一律取消”，也不以资源归属重写共享消费归属；更不把一次通过的多项检查视为已隔离的修复原因。对于已被接受的续行、重试调度和缓存刷新，须按其各自时序与资格条件处理。
